<p><span class="ma-inline-state" data-state="preliminary">Preliminary campaign</span></p>

<figure class="ma-figure-photo"><img src="/assets/img/photos/cards/tunshu.webp" alt="Field team walking in single file across a snow surface" width="900" height="600" fetchpriority="high"><div class="ma-photo-note"><span>MeteoAndes archive · 2026 campaign</span><span>Exact site and authorship pending validation</span></div><figcaption>Representative expedition image; exact identification must be validated.</figcaption></figure>

The inventory contains **21 samples**, TUN26_01–21, with a nominal maximum volume of **1.05 L**. A campaign graphic exists, but a publishable numerical comparison still requires duration, altitude, flow, ATN, meteorology and robust statistics.

A high-mountain session is a specific atmospheric window. It is not a climatology or the deposited load in ice.
